note: Legal basis for asking a bank to refund an annual card fee, and where to apply if it refuses. Not legal advice; the user checks the current text before sending.

legal_basis.title: 6502 sayılı Tüketicinin Korunması Hakkında Kanun, m. 31
legal_basis.summary: Art. 31(3): card issuers must offer consumers a credit card type for which no annual membership fee or similar charge is collected.
legal_basis.verified: Checked on the official text (mevzuat.gov.tr) 2026-11-25: 'Kart çıkaran kuruluşlar, tüketicilere yıllık üyelik aidatı ve benzeri isim altında ücret tahsil etmedikleri bir kredi kartı türü sunmak zorundadır.'

legal_basis.title: Finansal Tüketicilerden Alınacak Ücretlere İlişkin Tebliğ (TCMB, Sayı 2020/7), RG 07.03.2020, 31061, as amended
legal_basis.summary: Fees may be charged only for the listed products and services, only if agreed in the contract, and an increase must be notified in advance.
legal_basis.verified: Publication date and number from the Resmî Gazete index; later amendments were not checked.

legal_basis.title: BDDK, Bireysel Müşterilere İlişkin Ücretler (questions and answers)
legal_basis.summary: A no-fee card type must be offered; the annual fee accrues after the first debiting use; no fee while a card has had no movement for 180 days; a supplementary card fee is at most half of the main card's; complaints go to the bank first, then to TCMB or the banks' consumer arbitration committee.
legal_basis.verified: Points as summarised from the BDDK page by a search on 2026-11-25; the page itself was not opened.

hakem_heyeti.rule: Disputes worth less than this go to the provincial or district consumer arbitration committee (Tüketici Hakem Heyeti); from this amount up, to the consumer court, after mandatory mediation.
hakem_heyeti.act: Ticaret Bakanlığı tebliği, RG 23.12.2025, 33116 (6502 m. 68 limits revalued by 25,49 %)
hakem_heyeti.apply: online through e-Devlet (Tüketici Hakem Heyeti Başvurusu) or TÜBİS at https://tuketici.ticaret.gov.tr, at the committee of the consumer's place of residence or where the transaction took place
hakem_heyeti.alternative: Türkiye Bankalar Birliği Bireysel Müşteri Hakem Heyeti, https://www.tbb.org.tr/
hakem_heyeti.verified: Checked on the Resmî Gazete 2026-11-25: 186.000 TL from 1/1/2026, RG 23.12.2025, 33116. Same limit for provincial and district committees; where a district has no committee, apply through the kaymakamlık.

time_limit.note: Secondary sources disagree on how far back a fee refund can be claimed; kalan does not state a limit. The user should ask the bank or a lawyer.
